{{Recipe summary
| Category = Recipes for dessert
| Yield = 3 dozen
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Desserts]]

==Ingredients==
*1½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (200 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Sifter|sifted]] [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
*½ tsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*½ cup (120 g) [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
*1 cup (240 g) white [[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|granulated sugar]]
*½ cup (120 g) packed [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
*1 cup (240 g) coarsely-chopped [[cookbook:almond|almond]] [[Cookbook:Toffee|toffee]]
*1 tsp [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]] 

==Procedure==
# [[Cookbook:Sifter|Sift]] flour, baking powder and salt together.
# [[Cookbook:Creaming|Cream]] butter; add sugars and cream well. Add eggs and vanilla; beat until fluffy.
# Blend in dry ingredients. Stir in chopped almond toffee.
# Spread over bottom of well-greased 9 x 13-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (18 x 30 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) pan.
# [[Cookbook:Bake|Bake]] at 350°F (180°C) for about 30 minutes. When cool, cut into bars 3 inches (8 cm) long and 1 inch (2.5 cm) wide.
# Serve warm with your favorite cold beverage.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* If desired, bars may be frosted when cool with a white or chocolate butter [[Cookbook:Frosting|frosting]] before cutting. Sprinkle more crumbled toffee on top.
